WisconsinKiosk · redesign row F

Kiosk Pickup Rebuild

Pickup moves onto the task scaffold: blue for a personal pickup, violet for a shared case, Undo on every scan, off-plan scans answered inline, and a receipt that names what stays reserved.

Before = HEAD 1417e3c0 build, after = working tree; same created simulator, same fixture scenarios.

New frames (after only)

No before exists for these states: the old screen had no inline cards, no Undo, no shared styling, and no pickup receipt card.

What changed, and why

F1 pickup

Was

Adaptive split with ring and readiness badge; no Undo.

Now

Task scaffold, blue section, battery chips filled when scanned and outlined while still to scan, Undo on each confirmation (pickup scan DELETE).

F2 not on the reservation

Was

System dialog 'Add this item?' with Discard.

Now

Inline card with Put it back / Add MIC-12.

F3 substitute

Was

Unreachable: the scan route never sent a substitution.

Now

Scan route offers a like-for-like swap (same category or name); card offers Swap for MIC-09, Put it back, or add as an extra. Same-model suggestion list dropped (class d).

F4 shared case

Was

Same blue screen as a personal pickup.

Now

Violet section, 'For the team' list, 'Pick up for the team' pill, off-record hint.

F5 receipt

Was

Sentence only.

Now

Receipt card with scanned tags, due time, and an amber leftover line from confirm remainingItemNames.

Finishing with leftovers

Was

'Pick Up 3 Items' confirmed immediately.

Now

Asks first: 'MIC-09 and 1 × Sony Battery aren't scanned' / Keep scanning / Pick up 3.

Verification

  • xcodebuild WisconsinKiosk build (created iPad Air 11-inch (M4) iOS 26.5): pass
  • npx vitest run tests/ios-kiosk- + kiosk-pickup-substitute + kiosk-pickup-add: 20 files, 69 tests pass
  • npx tsc --noEmit: pass; git diff --check: pass

Things to know

  • Fixture captures prove rendering only. Undo, substitute, and confirm against a live server, plus scanner/camera/sound on hardware, are unverified.
  • Undo is withheld after an item is added to the plan or swapped in (clearing the scan would leave it reserved); the row's Remove is the way back.
  • F2 says 'It's free' without a date: the preflight returns no free-until time.
